title: review cycle (AF-609)
author: dev-blueprint (Amendment B build)

create.reason: cadence decays with baseline age; override wins
detect proposals from business-event records (NG-23) with numeric evidence
order by priority; apply nothing (NG-22); empty is valid
dormant-area, mode-mismatch, new-activity, propose-nothing, cadence decay, ordering, no mutation

agent_prompt: The review cycle reads the accumulated business-event records (NG-23) plus the active Schutzprofil baseline and proposes changes with numeric evidence + period. It applies nothing — the only path to the profile is an approved Änderungsantrag (NG-22). Cadence decays with baseline age (fortnightly<90d, monthly<180d, else quarterly) unless overridden. Proposing nothing is a valid outcome. TDD.
